newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kleinwort return on equity 20 pct - Dresdner.
newsitem.headline: Kleinwort return on equity 20 pct - Dresdner.

text.p: Dresdner Bank was on Thursday reported as saying its British investment banking unit Kleinwort Benson had achieved a return on equity of 20 percent before tax and that the return would increase next year.

Dresdner chief executive Juergen Sarrazin was cited in an interview with the Wirtschaftswoche business magazine as saying that the integration of Kleinwort, bought last year, had entailed substantial costs and would be completed in 1997.
"The yield will definitely be higher than it is now," Sarrazin said.
He added that Dresdner's domestic retail and corporate banking did not have "sufficient earnings quality" at the moment.
"The share of overall earnings generated by our foreign business is more than 50 percent and is continuing to grow," Sarrazin said.
